votes.motion: Approve the formal meeting minutes of July 19, 2022
votes.description: The Council approved the official meeting minutes from the July 19, 2022 formal session.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 29 of 2022 Declaring the Second Monday in October as Indigenous Peoples Day in Salt Lake City
votes.description: The Council and Mayor jointly declared the second Monday in October as Indigenous Peoples Day in Salt Lake City, honoring Indigenous peoples and their history.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 30 of 2022 Supporting a Phased, Lower Impact, Adaptive Approach to the Utah Department of Transportation's Little Cottonwood Canyon Environmental Impact Statement and opposing the gondola alternative
votes.description: The Council and Mayor jointly expressed opposition to the gondola alternative in UDOT's Little Cottonwood Canyon EIS, supporting instead a phased, lower-impact, adaptive approach.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer Items B-1 through B-4 to a future Consent Agenda for action
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on four grant applications (JAG, Utah Railroad Safety, YouthCity Snacks, and Urban Sustainability Directors Network) and referred them to a future consent agenda for action.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action on the Ballpark Station Area Plan to a future Council meeting
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed Ballpark Station Area Plan ordinance and deferred a final vote to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Other Side Village public benefits analysis and below market lease rate and term (item #6) and rezoning application (item #7), and defer action to a future Council meeting
votes.description: The Council closed the continued public hearing on both the lease authorization and rezoning for The Other Side Village tiny home project at 1850 West Indiana Avenue, deferring final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 62 of 2022 Green Street Alley Vacation
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance vacating a paper-only City-owned alley in the Marion Park Subdivision between 1300 South and Harrison Avenue and Green Street and 700 East, as abutting property owners had already incorporated it into their properties.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 63 of 2022 Budget Amendment No. 3 for Fiscal Year 2022-23 for specified items
votes.description: The Council adopted the third budget amendment for FY2022-23, covering items including refuse packer vehicles, governmental immunity funding, grant recognitions, UDOT reimbursements, and various federal and state grant fund allocations.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 31 of 2022 accepting a petition to annex property located at approximately 2200 West between 2800 North to 3300 North, and the Jordan River for future consideration
votes.description: The Council accepted an annexation petition for property near 2200 West between 2800 North and 3300 North, initiating the formal annexation process without constituting final approval.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 64 of 2022 approving the deferral of Emergency Loan Program loans to December 31, 2024, with legislative intents
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance deferring repayment of Emergency Loan Program loans (originally made to small businesses and nonprofits starting March 2020) to December 31, 2024, with legislative intents regarding opt-in deferral, repayment discounts, and forgiveness criteria.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 65 of 2022 regarding the Placement of Small Wireless Facilities in the Public Way
votes.description: The Council adopted an ordinance providing policy guidance for the placement of small cell wireless facilities in the public right-of-way.

votes.motion: Approve the consent agenda, except for item G1 which was removed with the revised agenda
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda items including board appointments and reappointments for the Police Civilian Review Board, Human Rights Commission, Airport Board, and Arts Council, excluding item G1 (1550 S Main Street rezone) which had been removed.
